name: How can a new entry door improve home security?
description: A new entry door improves security with stronger materials, reinforced frames, and advanced locking mechanisms, offering better protection against forced entry.

mainEntity.name: How can a new entry door improve home security?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new entry door can significantly enhance home security through stronger materials, improved locking mechanisms, and better frame integrity. Modern doors, particularly steel or solid core fiberglass, are more resistant to forced entry than older, weaker doors. They often come with reinforced strike plates, longer screws for hinges, and options for multi-point locking systems, which secure the door at multiple points along the frame, providing greater protection against break-ins.
